title: Kitchens
shortDescription: Copper pans catch the glow of an industrious oven.
longDescription:
The oven gives a steady, companionable roar. Copper pans hang in shining ranks above a flour-dusted table, and a row of bread tins cools beneath a cloth patched with embroidered turnips.
A recipe slate leans against a bowl big enough to bathe a very small dragon. Somewhere behind the pantry door, a spoon falls with tremendous importance.

fixtures.name: Recipe Slate
fixtures.examineDescription: The slate reads: 'Collegium soup: vegetables, water, herbs, and enough for the unexpected guest.' Underneath: 'Taste before adding salt. Ask before taking ingredients. Compliments to the washing-up crew count as compliments to the cook.'
